public_posts.text:
What a deeply disingenuous post.

AfriForum does not represent SA farmers or farming communities. @AgriSA1904 does but @USAmbRSA prefers to listen to a right-wing lobby group.

AfriForum does not need more money. They have billions but choose to spend only R2 of R10 on projects.

Dear @USAmbRSA, if you are really interested in the plight of farmers, you would meet with @AgriSA1904 soonest. Unlike AfriForum and other fringe actors, they represent the majority of SA’s 40 000 commercial farmers. This is what their CEO Johann Kotzé wrote yesterday.

Bookmark this. 📌

News24 reveals that Afriforum pumps millions (donated by people who want potholes fixed) into Orania, essentially a whites-only enclave.

March & March overlord replies: “Stand strong Kallie”. 

Connect the dots. 🔎
RT @MaxduPreez: Thank you, AfriForum and Solidarity. People are going to suffer because of your manufactured Afrikaner 'victimhood'.
Trump raises refugee ceiling by 10 000 to bring in more white South Africans 🤯😂
CORRUPTION. Trump Asked FIFA to Review U.S. Player’s Suspension. Now He’s Eligible to Play. https://t.co/NTUwW9goK0 via @NYTimes
Geordin Hill-Lewis | Courage and compromise birthed SA’s Constitution. We dare not fail it (Chirp: are the next president and deputy president of SA in this picture? 😉)
RT @News24: Tomorrow in News24's Sunday edition: The former DA leader spoke candidly about betrayal, lobbying by Tony Leon and the AfriMAGA…
While Trump fast-tracks Afrikaner ‘refugees’, more Americans are eyeing a move to SA

The high point of the relentless AfriForum-Solidarity and lately the FF Plus/Corné Mulder campaign in Washington. They inserted themselves into the MAGA movement, knew how to wrangle their story and found a receptive audience in the White House.

‘AfriMAGA’ celebrates Steenhuisen’s exit as Hill-Lewis moves to do damage control to DA brand https://www.news24.com/politics/afrimaga-celebrates-steenhuisens-exit-as-hill-lewis-moves-to-do-damage-control-to-da-brand-20260617-1252

Max du Preez on the rise of the new Afrikaner nationalists, how Solidarity-AfriForum sanitised their reputation with the help of Afrikaans newspapers, radio and television, and how powerful they really are. His new book is on the shelves today.
RT @MaxduPreez: Thank you, AfriForum and Solidarity. People are going to suffer because of your manufactured Afrikaner 'victimhood'.
AfriForum’s BEE payday: Empowerment critics invested R3m through ANC financier

What a circus. The IEC have released a statement that "it has not allowed any party, nor does it intend to allow any party" to register candidates post last Friday's deadline. And there was no "system glitch" as claimed by the ANC.
This is why the SSA wanted the Dlomo trial in camera: abuse of power, theft of resources and detail how the agency was pressed into service of the ANC.
Luthuli House link to SSA’s intelligence operation that targeted the EFF.

“[Kriel] did not see his way open to outright reject that statement. Instead, he argued that SAns should be thankful that Trump recognises SA’s problems. This creates doubt. How serious is AfriForum in its denial of a white genocide in this country?”

“But, according to a senior Solidarity source with direct knowledge of leadership decisions and thinking, the real motivation to insert itself into the affairs of Orania was a long-held desire to ‘control all Afrikaner institutions.’”

Full house at the Woordfees in Stellenbosch where I spoke to Max du Preez about his latest book, Aanstap Boere, about the resurgence of Afrikaner nationalism, the white right and the disappointment of the ANC. A wonderful conversation.

The Mashatile network is expansive, has access to resources and cuts across many spheres of government. Mashatile himself wants to be ANC leader and head of state, and we must understand the package deal we're getting.

https://t.co/fOHAnkcUUn
DA wins its first township ward in Emfuleni, beating ANC by 8 votes

@EdKieswetter @BusiMavuso2 identifies the role of the private sector, use of technology, the GNU and the president’s commitment to reform as signs of green shoots in the economy and society. But accountability remains key.

Excellent speech by the president at the 110th commemoration of the Battle of Delville Wood in France today. He pays tribute to fallen soldiers, to the black auxiliaries on the supply lines and to those who died on the SS Mendi. Really good. https://t.co/N5zILYoKk1 via @YouTube
Richard Calland | Four legal flaws in the impeachment panel report that could save Ramaphosa https://t.co/CRebxGpgSa

findings.quote: For the sake of the stability of our cities, Cyril Ramaphosa and Geordin Hill-Lewis should begin negotiating an ANC-DA omnibus deal, writes Adriaan Basson.

findings.quote: For the sake of the stability of our cities, Cyril Ramaphosa and Geordin Hill-Lewis should begin negotiating an ANC-DA omnibus deal, writes Adriaan Basson.

findings.evidence_notes: Paywalled. Parallel COL-01.

findings.quote: AfriForum does not represent SA farmers or farming communities. @AgriSA1904 does but @USAmbRSA prefers to listen to a right-wing lobby group.
findings.steelman_for: EiC arguing AgriSA is the broader farming voice and that AfriForum is ideologically right-wing is contested opinion grounded in membership claims.
findings.steelman_against: 'Right-wing lobby group' is a contested loaded label applied to AfriForum while dismissing its farming/safety work; US ambassador visit is treated as illegitimate listening.
findings.evidence_notes: AfriForum named in-text — direct actor tag (not AfriMAGA rule).

findings.quote: AfriForum does not need more money. They have billions but choose to spend only R2 of R10 on projects.
findings.steelman_for: Spending-ratio critique is a legitimate accountability angle if sourced to News24 investigations of AfriForum finances.
findings.steelman_against: Absolute 'billions' and R2-of-R10 claim presented as fact in a quote-tweet attack without sourcing in-post; fact_label Alleged pending article cross-check.
findings.evidence_notes: Spending claims Alleged in-post (no cite). Related Sunday investigation teasers exist but not re-audited here.

findings.quote: AfriForum does not represent SA farmers or farming communities. @AgriSA1904 does but @USAmbRSA prefers to listen to a right-wing lobby group.
findings.steelman_for: Pointing diplomats to the majority commercial-farmer body is a fair representation claim.
findings.steelman_against: FOR AgriSA is achieved by zero-sum exclusion of AfriForum rather than plural civil-society framing.
findings.evidence_notes: AgriSA as actor (farming body). Direction FOR.

findings.quote: Unlike AfriForum and other fringe actors, they represent the majority of SA’s 40 000 commercial farmers.
findings.steelman_for: Majority-representation claim for AgriSA is a measurable membership argument.
findings.steelman_against: 'Fringe actors' is a pejorative that minimises AfriForum's documented membership and rural-safety programmes.
findings.evidence_notes: Direct AfriForum name.

findings.quote: if you are really interested in the plight of farmers, you would meet with @AgriSA1904 soonest.
findings.steelman_for: Directing a diplomat to AgriSA is constructive advocacy for mainstream farming voice.
findings.steelman_against: Implies interest in farmers is illegitimate unless channelled through AgriSA.
findings.evidence_notes: FOR AgriSA.

findings.quote: News24 reveals that Afriforum pumps millions (donated by people who want potholes fixed) into Orania, essentially a whites-only enclave.
findings.steelman_for: EiC amplifying an investigation into donor funds diverted to Orania is accountability journalism.

findings.evidence_notes: Spending-to-Orania claim Established via News24 investigation teaser; 'whites-only' characterisation Disputed by Orania self-description — overall finding framing. First name Kallie kept as quoted (public CEO already named elsewhere).

findings.quote: RT @MaxduPreez: Thank you, AfriForum and Solidarity. People are going to suffer because of your manufactured Afrikaner 'victimhood'.
findings.steelman_for: Reposting a prominent commentator's critique of Afrikaner-victimhood politics is opinion amplification.
findings.steelman_against: EiC RT endorses 'manufactured … victimhood' causal blame on AfriForum without News24 evidence in-thread.
findings.evidence_notes: Cavus: RT = own amplification finding against Basson; adds no weight to Max du Preez original.

findings.quote: RT @MaxduPreez: Thank you, AfriForum and Solidarity. People are going to suffer because of your manufactured Afrikaner 'victimhood'.

findings.steelman_against: Same as X-07.

findings.steelman_against: 🤯😂 on an EiC account frames a documented US policy as absurd/laughable without argument, biasing readers AGAINST Trump/US before they open the piece.

findings.quote: CORRUPTION. Trump Asked FIFA to Review U.S. Player’s Suspension. Now He’s Eligible to Play.

findings.evidence_notes: Label existence Proven; whether conduct meets legal corruption Disputed/Not established from headline alone.

findings.quote: (Chirp: are the next president and deputy president of SA in this picture? 😉)

findings.steelman_against: EiC wink-endorsement of DA figures as next president/deputy elevates one party while sharing their constitutional op-ed.
